summary: Phase 6C.5 — UX bug-fix verification (navigation + escape + welcome credit + out-of-funds + /ai page). Backend 29/29 PASS (23 iter27 regression + 6 new iter28). Frontend critical user-reported bug VERIFIED FIXED: opening Concierge → 'take me to the vendors list' → URL becomes /partners?partner_type=vendor in <5s → panel AUTO-CLOSES → green sonner toast 'Navigated to /partners?partner_type=vendor' appears → vendor filter chip is the active (highlighted) chip on the Partners page. The larger 'X Close' pill (data-testid=assistant-close-btn) is visible on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844, 76x30 px). The /ai marketing page renders all expected testids (ai-overview-page, cost-table, ai-overview-signin, ai-overview-apply, 3 tool cards). On the Research Collaborator drawer for elena@birthright.org, the AiBalancePill (data-testid=ai-balance-pill) shows live '$9.92' in the drawer header. Welcome credit on partner approval: a brand-new community partner application got admin-approved and the user's wallet immediately showed balance_usd=1.00 with a 'welcome_credit' entry in recent_entries — confirmed end-to-end. Out-of-funds 402: research-collab/synthesize-literature returns 402 with detail containing 'min $0.01' regex-parseable substring after draining wallet to $0. Auto-recharge wiring: PUT /api/ai-wallet/auto-recharge round-trips threshold+amount+enabled; maybe_send_auto_recharge_email is defined in utils/ai_billing.py and dispatched as asyncio.create_task in record_usage(). Anonymous concierge still works without auth (no balance gate, 200 with navigate directive). All 23 prior iter27 ai-billing tests still pass after the welcome-credit code addition to routers/partners.py.
critical_code_review_comments: AiOutOfFundsCard.jsx correctly provides TWO escapes (top-up + back-to-page) — good UX defense for the user's 'I can't get back' complaint. The data-testid coverage (out-of-funds-card, out-of-funds-topup-btn, out-of-funds-back-btn) is complete.

Welcome credit grant in routers/partners.py (line 462-471) is properly wrapped in try/except, logged on failure, and idempotent via ref=f'welcome_{profile_id}' — re-approving will not double-credit. No regression to the 23 ai-billing tests confirmed.

maybe_send_auto_recharge_email is fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task — won't block the user's request even if Stripe/email is slow. Email-actually-sending was not tested per instructions; only code-path wiring was verified.

Minor: in the playwright test, after clicking assistant-close-btn the panel's is_visible() returned True even though screenshot confirmed it was hidden — this is a Playwright detached-element nuance, not a product bug (the panel is the fixed inset-0 overlay; after close it's unmounted but the query returned a stale handle in one test). The functional close works as proven by manual click and screenshot.

rca of the issue: User's bug 'can't navigate away from AI assistant + it doesn't navigate to pages I ask' was rooted in AssistantWidget's previous behavior: directive execution did not close the panel + error states had no in-panel escape. Fix (verified): (1) runDirective for type=navigate now sets open=false AND emits a sonner success toast — confirmed by the E2E flow where typing 'take me to the vendors list' resulted in URL=/partners?partner_type=vendor + panel hidden + toast 'Navigated to /partners?partner_type=vendor'. (2) 402 error rendering inline as an out-of-funds bubble with Top-up + Back buttons — verified by code review of AssistantWidget.jsx (data-testid=assistant-out-of-funds-{id}, out-of-funds-card has both onClose and goToWallet escapes). (3) Larger close pill in header — verified visible on mobile (76x30px) and desktop. All three escape mechanisms are now wired correctly. Backend supports this with: navigate-action emission for vendor/facilitator/community/research filtered routes (verified by direct API call returning proposed_actions[0].params.path='/partners?partner_type=vendor' with tier=auto, execute=frontend); 402 with 'min $X.XX' detail for regex-parseability by the frontend AiOutOfFundsCard; welcome_credit $1 grant on approval for first-time UX.
